input.title: Building the Powerhouse monorepo requires bun 1.3 alongside Node ≥24 and pnpm 11, because the postbuild steps of ph-cli, ph-cmd and registry shell out to it

input.description: pnpm build cannot finish without bun. Bin warnings on a first install are expected until pnpm build + pnpm rebuild --recursive. reactor-browser tests also need playwright install chromium.

metadata.reason: Extracted from README.md at v6.2.2-dev.74 — How to Run this Repo › Prerequisites and Steps; Linking Dependencies; How to contribute
The post-merge release automation this note mentions is the pipeline described there

input.content:
| Tool | Version | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Node.js | `>=24` (see `engines.node`) | |
| pnpm | 11.x | CI installs `latest` via `pnpm/action-setup` |
| bun | 1.3.x | **Required to build.** The `postbuild` steps of `ph-cli`, `ph-cmd` and `registry` shell out to it, so `pnpm build` cannot finish without it |

The repo uses pnpm workspaces and Nx. The sequence is `pnpm install` → `pnpm build` → `npx nx <target> <project>` (e.g. `npx nx start @powerhousedao/switchboard`). Bin warnings on a first install (`Failed to create bin … dist/cli.mjs`) are expected — the targets do not exist until the packages are built — and clear after `pnpm build` + `pnpm rebuild --recursive`. `playwright install chromium` is additionally needed before `pnpm --filter=@powerhousedao/reactor-browser run test`; without it most of that package's test files cannot launch a browser and are skipped.

Linking a local dependency is `"@pgph/pkg-a": "workspace:*"` in `package.json` plus a `references` path entry in `tsconfig.json`. Contributions go through feature branches off `main` with conventional commits scoped to one package (`feat(document-model): …`); a GitHub Action versions and releases the affected packages after merge.

_Source: README.md (Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.74)._
